summary: United States Gasoline Fund, LP filed an 8-K reporting that The Marygold Companies, Inc. (TMC), its indirect parent through USCF, agreed on September 25, 2026 to be taken private by Madison Dearborn Partners in an all-cash transaction. TMC stockholders must approve, and regulatory and change-of-control approvals are required. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027 or earlier. Post-close, TMC shares will delist from the NYSE, and MDP will pursue USCF's previously announced transformation strategy. No per-share price, premium, or break fee was disclosed. Watch for stockholder vote timing, regulatory clearances, and any impact on UGA's GP ownership or fund operations.
